CMU Motion Capture BVH clips

Source: CMU Graphics Lab Motion Capture Database
URL: https://mocap.cs.cmu.edu/

Bundled clips:
- 02_01_walk.bvh: subject 02, trial 01, walk
- 09_01_run.bvh: subject 09, trial 01, run
- 13_01_sit-stand.bvh: subject 13, trial 01, sit on high stool / stand up

The data used in this project was obtained from mocap.cs.cmu.edu.
The database was created with funding from NSF EIA-0196217.
